family: goBILDA 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor
shaftNotes: 8 mm REX is goBILDA's hybrid shaft profile, not a plain hex: an 8 mm round section combined with a 7 mm hex section. The round part runs in 8 mm round-bore bearings; the hex part gives positive drive to REX-bore hubs, pulleys and wheels, so treat it as a hex drive (goBILDA 8 mm REX shaft SKU 2106-4008-0800; the old URL https://www.gobilda.com/2106-series-stainless-steel-rex-shaft-8mm-diameter-80mm-length/ now redirects to https://www.gobilda.com/8mm-rex-shaft-with-e-clip-stainless-steel-80mm-length/; background: https://www.gobilda.com/blog/8mm-rex-the-shaft-youve-been-waiting-for/). Every 5203 spec table reads RS-555 brushed DC, 12 VDC nominal, planetary with steel gears, output shaft 8 mm REX, 24 mm length; the category page (https://www.gobilda.com/yellow-jacket-planetary-gear-motors/) adds that the shaft steps up to 9 mm inside the 36 mm gearbox head on two ball bearings. Shaft lengths: there is no 48 mm Yellow Jacket. The long-shaft twin is the 5204 Series (5204-8002-00xx, 8 mm REX, 80 mm length), 10 ratios from 3.7:1 to 188:1 with no 1:1; its speed, currents, stall torque and encoder resolution match the 5203 of the same ratio (re-checked live on 3.7:1 and 19.2:1), so a 5204 uses the same row here. The 11 ratios below are the complete 5203 lineup on the category page. ratio is goBILDA's nominal label; the exact planetary ratios, from stages of 1+46/17 and 1+46/11, are 3.7:1 = 3.7059, 5.2:1 = 5.1818, 13.7:1 = 13.7336, 19.2:1 = 19.2032, 26.9:1 = 26.8512, 50.9:1 = 50.8950, 71.2:1 = 71.1648, 99.5:1 = 99.5075, 139:1 = 139.1382, 188:1 = 188.6108. encoderPPR = counts per output-shaft revolution = 28 x exact ratio, goBILDA's own formula. The 71.2:1 page prints 1,993.6 (28 x the rounded 71.2) while its formula gives 1992.6; 1992.6 is used. freeRpm is goBILDA's theoretical no-load speed at 12 V; the bare 5000-series motor page (5000-0002-4008) lists 6000 rpm theoretical and 5800 rpm tested. No-load current 0.25 A and stall current 9.2 A are motor figures and are identical on every page. Stall torque is as printed, converted at 1 kg.cm = 0.0980665 N.m. Not included: 5202 Series (6 mm D-shaft), 5303/5304 Saturn motors (8 mm REX but 24 V RS-560, and goBILDA says they are not FTC legal), the 5000-0002-4008 bare motor with a REX pinion (no gearbox; electrically the 1:1 row), 5103 gearboxes (no motor). All 11 product pages were fetched live on 2026-09-12: HTTP 200, no redirects, spec tables parsed from the HTML.
